explanation: Heavy (m=20) vs light (m=0.2) elastic collision slingshots body 1 to ~297 u/s. At dt=1/30 it travels ~10 units per recorded step (7.23,6.94 at step 80 to 12.77,1.65 at step 81), jumping clean over the 0.5x0.5 wall at (9,5). Substepping (~330 substeps) does not prevent the centre crossing between consecutive recorded steps, so no_tunneling fires.
